Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring full payment of all moneys due under the certificate of delinquency prior to any change of ownership of real property after a certificate of delinquency is issued.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring full payment of all moneys due underthe certificate of delinquency prior to any change of ownership of realproperty after a certificate of delinquency is issued; and adding a newsection to chapter 84.64 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.64 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For real property, after a certificate of delinquency has beenissued thereon and prior to the day of the sale, no change in ownershipof the real property may be made until all moneys due under thecertificate of delinquency are paid in full.
